mentions.name: Blorp
mentions.description: Blorp is a programming language inspired by Python, Rust, Go, and functional programming, oriented toward readability, safety, and speed. The compiler is being fully self-hosted ahead of an initial release.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Blorp. https://blorp-lang.org

It takes inspiration from Python, Rust, Go, and functional programming. It's oriented toward readability, safety, and speed.

mentions.name: Blorp
mentions.description: A programming language (Blorp) that is now self-hosted, with its syntactic surface, standard library, and initial dependency strategy on a decent footing; a 0.0.1 release is being prepped.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://blorp-lang.org

Taking a bit of a detour with self-hosting the language, now that the syntactic surface, standard library, and initial dependency strategy are on a decent footing.

With any luck, by the end of the week, I'll start prepping for a 0.0.1 release.
